author: onlinekira93vs
quote: Honestly, I'm extremely disappointed with Grand Theft Auto VI. The game feels like a glitchy mess, and the constant problems make it practically unplayable for me. This isn't the GTA experience I was hoping for. I genuinely enjoy playing GTA V and the other GTA games much more. They gave me the enjoyment and experience I expect from this **** my opinion, this game does not deserve Game of the Year, and I certainly don't think it deserves a 99 score. I wanted to love GTA VI after waiting so long, but right now I simply can't. Rockstar, this is not what I expected. Very disappointing.
